method: breaths by loudness (under -20 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 11 of 12 breaks heard

lines.latin: Creátor alme síderum, Ætérna lux credéntium,
lines.english: Gracious Creator of the stars, everlasting light of believers,

lines.latin: Jesu, Redémptor ómnium, Inténde votis súpplicum.
lines.english: Jesus, Redeemer of all, give ear to the prayers of Thy suppliants.

lines.latin: Qui dǽmonis ne fráudibus Períret orbis, ímpetu
lines.english: Thou who, lest the world should perish by the deceits of the devil, by the force

lines.latin: Amóris actus, lánguidi Mundi medéla factus es.
lines.english: of love wast moved to become the healing of a languishing world.

lines.latin: Commúne qui mundi nefas Ut expiáres, ad crucem
lines.english: Who, to atone for the common guilt of the world, to the Cross

lines.latin: E Vírginis sacrário Intácta prodis víctima.
lines.english: from the Virgin's sanctuary camest forth, a spotless Victim.

lines.latin: Cujus potéstas glóriæ, Noménque cum primum sonat,
lines.english: At whose glorious power, and at whose Name as soon as it sounds,

lines.latin: Et cǽlites et ínferi Treménte curvántur genu.
lines.english: both those in heaven and those below bow with trembling knee.

lines.latin: Te deprecámur, últimæ Magnum diéi Júdicem,
lines.english: We beseech Thee, the great Judge of the last day:

lines.latin: Armis supérnæ grátiæ Defénde nos ab hóstibus.
lines.english: with the arms of heavenly grace defend us from our foes.

lines.latin: Virtus, honor, laus, glória Deo Patri cum Fílio,
lines.english: Power, honour, praise and glory to God the Father with the Son,

lines.latin: Sancto simul Paráclito, In sæculórum sǽcula.
lines.english: together with the Holy Paraclete, for ever and ever.
